title: After Your Tenth Bead, It ISN'T Them 🤫
description:
Everyone here gets ten words a day, worn as ten glass beads round your neck. Every word turns one of them dark. Mine never go dark at all.

My mom leads the village choir, and she says I never listen. This week she keeps thanking me for our long talks in her kitchen, late into the night. I was never there.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment AH if you'd have known it wasn't him.
